stories.title: Salesforce Completes $3.6B Acquisition of Fin (Formerly Intercom), Folding 76%-Resolution AI Agent into Agentforce
stories.body: Salesforce closed its acquisition of Fin — the customer-service AI company formerly known as Intercom — on September 10, 2026, for approximately $3.6 billion, bringing more than 30,000 business customers onto the Salesforce platform. Fin's AI Agent claims to resolve 76% of support volume without a human across live chat, email, WhatsApp, SMS, phone, and Slack, powered by Apex, a proprietary model purpose-built for support. The deal folds Fin's autonomous support technology directly into Agentforce, Salesforce's AI-agent platform, creating a combined CRM-plus-agent stack that competes head-on with Sierra, Decagon, and Ada.
stories.why: This is the single biggest competitive landscape shift of the quarter for any agent vendor: the most-deployed helpdesk CRM now ships a pre-trained, outcome-priced AI agent at $0.99 per resolution, raising the 'why buy point-solution' objection on every enterprise call. Sellers need to be ready to position Graas against a bundled Salesforce offer and explain what a context layer or knowledge graph delivers that a packaged CRM agent cannot.

stories.title: Dell Extends AI Data Platform with Unified Semantic Layer, Enterprise Knowledge Graph, and Knowledge Agents
stories.body: Dell announced three new extensions to its Data Orchestration Engine — a Unified Semantic Layer, an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, and Knowledge Agents — explicitly designed to turn fragmented enterprise data into trusted, reusable context for agentic AI. The Unified Semantic Layer establishes a common business vocabulary across structured and unstructured data, while the Knowledge Graph maps entity relationships including metadata, lineage, and query history so agents can traverse information across tables, vector indexes, and multimodal data. Dell also plans to incorporate Nvidia's open-source Auto-Ontology technology to automate knowledge-graph construction from enterprise data estates, with general availability targeted for the first half of 2027.
stories.why: Dell shipping a named, integrated semantic-layer-plus-knowledge-graph-plus-agent stack from a Tier-1 infrastructure vendor validates exactly the architecture argument Graas makes: agents without governed context produce wrong answers. Sellers can use this announcement to anchor the 'data foundation before agents' conversation and show that the market's largest hardware/software vendors are converging on context layers as the missing enterprise AI ingredient.

stories.title: McKinsey State of Organizations 2026: 88% Deploy AI, 81% Report No Meaningful Bottom-Line Impact, 86% Feel Unprepared
stories.body: McKinsey's State of Organizations 2026, drawing on 10,018 senior executives across 15 countries and 16 industries, found that while 88% of organizations are deploying AI in at least parts of their operations, 81% report no meaningful bottom-line gains and only 1% of C-suite respondents describe their generative AI rollouts as mature. Critically, 86% of leaders said their organization is not prepared to adopt AI in day-to-day operations, and one in six reported no clear C-suite owner of AI. The report's retail-specific overlay, published in June 2026, adds that fewer than 30% of retail organizations have reached established or embedded levels of AI strategy, and only about 30% report advanced AI governance capabilities.
stories.why: This is the sharpest quantitative proof that AI pilots stall at the data-and-governance layer, not at the model layer — the exact problem Graas solves. Sellers can open discovery calls with the 88%/81% gap to surface the client's own readiness crisis and position Graas's context layer as the organizational fix that converts experimentation into EBIT impact.

stories.title: BCG: Agentic AI in CPG–Retailer Supply Chains Delivers +2–4% In-Stock Improvement and 40–60% Drop in Admin Costs
stories.body: A BCG report published August 2026 on CPG–retailer collaboration found that agentic AI agents monitoring store- and DC-level inventory signals against sell-through velocity can proactively push replenishment recommendations before a retailer's own replenishment cycle would detect an out-of-stock, boosting in-stocks by 2–4% and planning productivity by over 60%. A separate BCG supply chain case study showed that when supply chain managers were empowered by AI agents, administration costs fell 40–60% and fill rates rose. BCG also cautions that only about 10% of consumer goods and retail companies have integrated AI agents across their teams and workflows, and just 7% report value from agentic or generative AI specifically.
stories.why: These are named, quantified CPG and retail outcomes from a Big-3 consulting firm — exactly the proof-point a seller needs to move a prospect from 'interesting' to 'business case.' The 10%/7% integration figures also reinforce the sales narrative: the gap between potential and realized value is the data-foundation problem, which is what Graas exists to close.

stories.title: Sierra Hits $200M ARR and $15.8B Valuation After $950M Series E; Launches Horizon Outbound and Voice Personas
stories.body: Sierra raised a $950 million Series E in May 2026 led by Tiger Global and Google's GV at a post-money valuation of $15.8 billion, reaching an estimated $200M in annualized revenue. In July 2026 Sierra launched Horizon, extending its platform into outbound customer engagement, and in August 2026 added Voice Personas, moving the product beyond inbound support into proactive, voice-led customer interactions. Competing directly, Decagon reached an estimated $100M in annualized revenue by August 2026 and is reportedly exploring a sale, while Sierra's Ghostwriter tool (launched March 2026) allows teams to build and edit agents from prompts, SOPs, or call recordings.
stories.why: Sierra is now the best-funded pure-play conversational agent vendor at $1.6B raised, moving aggressively into outbound and voice — channels that retail and CPG enterprises use for order management, reorder prompts, and B2B service. Sellers competing alongside or against Sierra need to understand that Sierra's strength is orchestration speed, while its acknowledged gap remains enterprise context grounding — the layer Graas provides.
